'''Gellak''', nicknamed '''Gunmetal Gellak''', was a notorious [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]]. A group of [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] were hired to catch the pirate; ending his business during the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="G2" />
